usedFor: Help Scout holds support conversations and Sangam CRM holds leads, so “Update Customer” can feed “Create or Update Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “Update Customer” in Help Scout, then “Create or Update Lead” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: A changed customer record in Help Scout updates the matching lead instead of leaving the CRM stale.

watchOut: “Create or Update Lead” matches by ID, email or phone, so send one of those from the customer.
